title: 🧹 Avoid resizing arrays in Transition.cs Add method
body:
🎯 What: Pre-calculate the required array capacity in TransitionsList.Add(TransitionsList other) before iterating to avoid multiple array re-allocations.
💡 Why: Resizing arrays is slow due to memory allocation and copying. Calculating the total needed size beforehand and doing one resize operation improves performance significantly when adding a list of transitions.
✅ Verification: Read the source code and executed full verify sweep to ensure tests pass.
✨ Result: Replaced multiple SetCapacity calls with an O(1) single resize.
